notes: Access route: r.jina.ai proxy with percent-encoded target URL + header x-return-format:html (direct HTTP/curl_cffi to surya.com is 403'd by Cloudflare managed challenge per prior-pass notes; this proxy route is still tier-1 HTTP, no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed). Main nav (fetched homepage https://www.surya.com/) exposes a dedicated top-level item data-test-selector=mainNavigationLink-TopSellers labelled 'Top Sellers' at href=/Catalog/Top-Sellers, distinct from all product-category nav items (Rugs/Furniture/Lighting/Textiles/Wall Decor/Accents/Outdoor). Opened the page: <title>Top Sellers - Surya | ...</title>, meta description 'Top Sellers', and 24 real product tiles rendered (data-test-selector=productListProductCard<guid> x24, productDescriptionLink x48, productImage present) confirming a genuine PLP, not editorial/marketing. This is a single flat/undifferentiated listing - no subCategories/childCategories field in the page's Optimizely/Insite SSR state blob, so emitted as one row (no site-exposed sub-structure to preserve). Checked also for 'Ready to Ship' (present in prior-pass notes as a separate nav-only node) - not a Bestsellers-type term per brief Section 3, correctly out of scope for this file.
